subject: Fix strike resolution one frame early (f19137) + side-step misattribution
description: DONE in two parts. The lateral-strike f19137 mismatch came from seed geometry: Original uses ground-space direction plus full 3D range, while Rust used map space and incorrectly admitted Pc192. The separate linux2/P002/Savegame_003 side-step RNG family was not association cadence: numeric substate 155 is RunningToEnemy, and Original Soldier183 takes that attack opportunity. Original GetDirectionVector aspect-scales Y; Rust used an unscaled sector vector for the target-behind dot product, flipped the diagonal half-plane test, fell through to CombatObserveSideStep, and consumed the extra draw. The isometric vector clears replay-002 f13985 and replay-006's cluster; both advance to later unrelated frontiers (#46 tracks replay-002 f14266).
